digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport layer
propositions: When JIRA_PAT environment variable is absent, settings.py returns empty string instead of failing, causing the transport layer to construct an unauthenticated client and fall back to anonymous Jira access.
Missing JIRA_PAT produces misleading error messages (like 'project does not exist') that misattribute the failure to wrong root cause, hindering operator debugging.
The documented security guarantee that 'missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable' is not enforced in the code, contradicting the user guide.

Client construction in build_client_from_settings must validate that JIRA_PAT is non-empty before creating the Jira client, rejecting whitespace-only values and naming the variable in the error message.

Settings resolution must remain total (not raise on missing credential) to preserve Python 3.11+ Protocol conformance checks via hasattr, with the validation guard moved to client construction instead.
